title: Autonomic nervous system anatomy
description: The unconscious half of the nervous system: sympathetic accelerator, parasympathetic brake, and the gut's own enteric brain.

questions.question: What is the difference between sympathetic and parasympathetic nerves?
questions.answer: Both are autonomic pathways. Sympathetic activity often prepares organs for exertion; parasympathetic pathways support many resting functions. Their effects depend on the organ and receptor.

questions.question: Where are autonomic ganglia located?
questions.answer: Sympathetic ganglia lie in chains beside the spine or in prevertebral groups; many parasympathetic ganglia lie near or within their target organs.

questions.question: What is the sympathetic trunk?
questions.answer: Paired chain from neck to sacrum beside vertebrae. Function: Mass fight-or-flight discharge.

questions.question: Where is the coeliac ganglion & plexus located?
questions.answer: Largest prevertebral relay at T12/L1, around coeliac trunk. Function: Foregut sympathetic supply.

questions.question: What is the function of the inferior mesenteric ganglion?
questions.answer: Function: Hindgut and pelvic sympathetic supply. Relay at IMA origin.
